**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What's there:** Section 5 warrants only legal compliance (5(a)), authority/rights (5(b)), non-infringement (5(c)) and anti-bribery (5(d)), followed by an "in lieu of all other warranties" disclaimer (5(e)). Section 1(b) has a general workmanlike-performance covenant, and Section 4 — despite its "ACCEPTANCE" heading — contains no acceptance/rejection mechanic.
- **What's missing:** any warranty that the Services or Works conform to the Specifications/documentation, any warranty duration, and any repair/re-perform/refund remedy. That fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies).
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 5(e) warranting workmanlike performance plus 90-day conformity of the Works to the Specifications, with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund at Contractor's option; disclaimer renumbered to 5(f). No carve-out was needed because the existing disclaimer already preserves express warranties.
